direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh at 1366x768, overflow hidden: 48px header / 40px compact horizontal rail / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar. Compact horizontal rail only, equal-width non-wrapping targets at least 36px with aria-current and arrow-key movement. Enlarge the rendered scene to at least 70% of main; reserve independent non-overlapping zones for callouts, stations and jobs, condensing side content inside its zone without inspector scrolling.
direction.colorTokens: Entirely black, emerald and brushed silver: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22); silver #C5CCD4 headings and machine bodies, dim silver rgba(197,204,212,.68) secondary text; emerald #A8F04A sole accent and primary fill with #050705 text, one primary per viewport. Stopped states: silver cross-hatching, x marker and plain OFFLINE text, never red. Official logo immutable in black, emerald and brushed silver at native aspect, exactly two placements: header and opening story.
direction.typography: System sans; 16px/24 body minimum, no label under 12px; header tabs span most of the header with labels at least 16px; 24/30 stage title, 18/24 panel title, 12/16 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step, minimal narration.
direction.motion: Living material flow, state glow, depth and cinematic transitions driven by real state: 160-220ms ease-out selection, one 240ms route trace on state change then settled; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions and flow while pattern, x marker and OFFLINE text retain meaning. 2px emerald focus ring with 2px offset; pointer style only on enabled controls.
direction.components: Header with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries the second required logo placement. Side zone keeps connection readiness checks for provider identity separate from the investigation evidence task under distinct headings, status and controls. Action bar: Back left, status centre, one primary right. Selecting a recovery option opens one-click Approve, then Authorize this decision wall. Pending task proposals stay deliberately untracked until human approval; blocked prior tasks and an approved recovery plan may coexist while replacement tasks await approval. Tab order: skip-to-stage, header, rail, SVG nodes, side zone, action bar; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite for results.
direction.visualizations: Focusable cinematic factory SVG 960x540 enlarged to fill at least 70% of main from real state: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes emerald only, silver idle machines, stopped CELL-MILL-2 in silver cross-hatching with x marker and plain OFFLINE, no route through it; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap inside stage bounds; bidirectional SVG-to-side-zone highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline/Feasible-Accepted legend using pattern, marker and text.
